interface_contract.issue_order: strict PC order with no lookahead past blocked current PC

implemented_behavior.request_policy: typed valid/start is independent of ready/busy and payload remains stable while blocked
implemented_behavior.pending_policy: MM2S by destination tag, S2MM by source tag, SA by output bank plus stored source tuple
implemented_behavior.release_policy: matching executor responses release ownership independently of current PC
implemented_behavior.error_policy: stop issue, continue response acceptance, terminate only after pending and external busy drain
implemented_behavior.end_policy: wait for all pending entries and all external busy inputs to clear
